book.description: AT-URI of the catalog edition whose highlighted passages to rank.

limit.description: Maximum number of passages to return, most-highlighted first.

passage.description: One passage, as the most recent reader to highlight it wrote it.

createdAt.description: When that newest record was first published.

locator.description: That record's anchor, when it has one. A locator from another reader's format may not resolve in a local copy of the edition.

quote.description: The passage, on the scale of the newest record that quotes it.

readers.description: How many distinct readers highlighted this passage.

uri.description: AT-URI of the newest `readingProgress` record quoting the passage.

description: The passages most readers highlighted in one catalog edition, ranked by how many distinct readers quoted them. A passage is a `readingProgress` record's `annotation.quote`, normalised (whitespace collapsed, case folded) before it is counted, so two readers who highlighted the same sentence with different spacing and capitalisation land on one entry. A passage needs at least two distinct readers and at least 16 characters of text; nothing else decides membership.
